verdict.rationale: Firstbase's own registered-agent page says it offers registered-agent service in all 50 states, priced per state. It also says adding a new state is done by selecting it on the compliance dashboard, which avoids finding a new vendor. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of multi-state registered-agent coverage, and no mention of DC or territories.

support.subject: As a founder, one provider covers registered-agent service in every US state, so registering in a new state does not mean finding a new vendor

citations.quote: Registered Agent available in all 50 states
Need to expand your business to a new state? No problem. Just select a state on your compliance dashboard and we'll take care of it for you.
Get an instant overview of your company's status in each state.
